acceptedAnswer.text: A weight loss clinic should consider investing in AI Overviews optimization when looking to enhance its digital presence, drive more qualified leads, and stay competitive in the evolving search landscape. It's particularly beneficial if your target audience frequently searches for health information or solutions online.
